### Read the Bible: Numbers 30, Psalm 74, Isaiah 22, 2 Peter 3
Author: D.A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/numbers-30-psalm-74-isaiah-22-2-peter-3/
Passage: Numbers 30:1-16
Points:
- A society's litigiousness reflects a deeper cultural failure to keep promises and tell the truth.
- Discarding personal and marriage vows paves the way for abandoning covenant commitments to God.
- Under the Mosaic law, anyone making a vow or pledge was bound to keep their word without compromise.
- Family and spousal responsibilities regulate individual oaths, but the underlying biblical command is absolute fidelity.

### Keeping Our Vows
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/keeping-our-vows
Passage: Numbers 30:2
Points:
- God takes our vows seriously because invoking His name makes oaths a sacred matter.
- Breaking our word undermines the sacredness of truth, which God requires in our inner beings.
- Jesus modeled ultimate promise-keeping by submitting to the Father and willingly going to the cross.
- Believers have Christ as an advocate when they fail, and the Spirit empowers them to maintain integrity.
